title: October 26, 1890: a journalist was born who gave Bhagat Singh his first writing job - and died trying to stop a riot.

sources.text: The Wire - The Editor Who Lived and Died for Communal Harmony

caption:
October 26, 1890: a journalist was born who gave Bhagat Singh his first writing job - and died trying to stop a riot.

He founded the Hindi newspaper Pratap in 1913, campaigning for peasants and mill workers under British rule - work that got him prosecuted and jailed five separate times.

Nehru said of his death that "he taught in his death what we will find difficult to teach while living for many years." India later issued a commemorative stamp in his honour and named an annual journalism award after him.

Vidyarthi's five prison terms and the way he died are a reminder that institutional freedoms India now takes for granted were paid for, one newspaper and one life at a time.
